subject: Renewal proposal: usage-buffered commit and transient rate anchor
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sophia Tan <sophia.tan@pinecrest.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal proposal: usage-buffered commit and transient rate anchor

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Based on Pinecrest's growth trajectory and the burst patterns you shared, I put together a renewal proposal that aims to balance predictability for you with operational efficiency on our side. Key points in this draft (attached):

- 12-month renewal starting 2026-07-01
- Baseline commit: 12M inference units / month (replaces current 8M)
- Usage-buffer (surge bucket): 3M IU/month available for burst at a capped overage rate
- Transient rate anchor: a 90-day price hold on base committed unit rate if signed by 2026-06-15
- One-time onboarding credit: $45k USD applied as invoice credit on next cycle if we miss 95th percentile latency SLA in the first month
- Invoice smoothing: option to split the annual prepay into 3 equal payments (if procurement needs PO timing)

I attached the term sheet v3 and a procurement PO template to speed procurement. If this looks directionally correct, can we schedule a 30-min call Wed or Thu to lock the commercial points and scope any legal redlines?

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference
From: Sophia Tan <sophia.tan@pinecrest.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@pinecrest.com
Date: 2026-06-01T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: usage-buffered commit and transient rate anchor

Lauren —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear options. A few initial notes from procurement and engineering:

- The baseline bump is in line with our forecast, but the finance team needs a deeper committed discount on the unit rate for the first 6 months to justify the budget shift.
- We need the surge bucket at a lower overage cap — can you move the cap down 10%?
- The 90-day price hold is helpful; would you consider extending to 120 days if we commit to the 12M baseline?
- Procurement timeline: we need a signed agreement and an issued PO by 2026-06-30 to align with our quarterly close.

Can you share an updated term sheet reflecting (a) 6-month step-down discount on the committed unit rate, (b) reduced overage cap, and (c) a 120-day hold option? Also please call out any operational limits on the surge bucket (e.g., per-minute throttles).

Best —
Sophia
Sophia Tan | Head of Data Products, Pinecrest Retail
sophia.tan@pinecrest.com
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sophia Tan <sophia.tan@pinecrest.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-02T10:24:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: usage-buffered commit and transient rate anchor

Sophia —

Thanks, noted. Looping in Karthik (pricing) and Marissa (revenue ops) so we can get an approved counter in one round. Quick responses inline to your asks:

- 6-month step-down: we can structure a graded discount for months 1–6 (bigger discount month 1–3, taper months 4–6) instead of a flat upfront concession — retains runway for you while protecting unit economics.
- Surge cap: we can lower the overage rate by 10% but ask for a modest increase in the one-time credit to keep the blended economics neutral.
- Price hold extension to 120 days if signature by 2026-06-15 — acceptable with an added minimum commitment clause (commits locked for the first 90 days, then monthly true-ups).
- Operational note: surge bucket is enforced at an account level with a 60-second continuous usage throttle and backpressure on concurrent streams beyond 1.5x baseline sustained. I'll add precise language in the term sheet.

Attached: redlined term sheet v4 with the above changes. Karthik/Marissa — quick ask: can we authorize a $60k onboarding credit and approve the 10% overage reduction if Pinecrest signs by 2026-06-15? This will be the final concession.

Available for a call tomorrow afternoon.

— Lauren
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-03T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: usage-buffered commit and transient rate anchor

Lauren / Karthik —

I reviewed the numbers. Approve the $60k onboarding credit and the 10% overage reduction as a one-time concession contingent on: signed agreement and PO received by 2026-06-30. Finance will prepare a 3-way invoice schedule template for invoice smoothing; include it in the final appendix.

One caution: do not extend further concessions (e.g., free burst hours) without a documented exec sign-off. If Pinecrest requests the 120-day hold, make sure the minimum-commit clause is explicit — we need the ability to true-up if usage deviates >30% vs. baseline in months 2–4.

Marissa Cole | VP, Revenue Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Sophia Tan <sophia.tan@pinecrest.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@pinecrest.com
Date: 2026-06-04T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: usage-buffered commit and transient rate anchor

Lauren / Marissa / Karthik —

Thank you — the revised term sheet looks good to procurement. We accept the $60k onboarding credit and the 10% overage reduction provided the signature/PO timeline is met. We will aim to sign by 2026-06-15 to secure the 120-day hold.

Next steps: I will route the attached term sheet to our legal and procurement teams today and push for a PO and signature. Please send the DocuSign envelope once you have the final appendix with the invoice schedule.

Sophia
